title: Astronomers Discover the First Moon Beyond Our Solar System!

scenes.text: Astronomers have found a moon beyond our solar system!

scenes.label: FIRST OF ITS KIND
scenes.text: This moon orbits a distant exoplanet called Kepler-1625b.

scenes.label: LARGE AND UNIQUE
scenes.text: It is about the size of Neptune, making it extraordinarily large for a moon.

scenes.label: SIGNIFICANT FINDING
scenes.text: This discovery opens up new possibilities for moon exploration in outer space.
Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Astronomers have made an incredible discovery by finding the first known moon outside our solar system. Follow for daily science!
